name: a11y-angular-fix-and-test
description: Applies each fix plan task in an Angular codebase one task at a time: writes a failing axe-core plus `@testing-library/angular` test on the TestBed fixture first, makes the smallest template change using native elements and Angular CDK a11y (`cdkTrapFocus`, `LiveAnnouncer`, `FocusMonitor`) and the Router `title` strategy, enables the angular-eslint template accessibility rules, and commits only when test, lint and suite pass.
